content: Wisdom is like a colossal baobab tree: no single person's arms can embrace it alone.
author: African Proverbs
sourceWork: Nyansa nye sika na w'akyekyere asie — Akan Proverb (Ghana)
explanation: The ancient baobab tree has a trunk twenty meters in circumference. A solitary seeker attempting to wrap their arms around it barely covers an eighth of the bark. Comprehensive wisdom requires the collective intelligence of elders, youth, artisans, and storytellers holding hands.
practicalInsight: Acknowledge that your perspective is only one small arc of the baobab tree. Invite other viewpoints to complete the circle.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you acting as if you personally possess the entire trunk of wisdom, refusing to link hands with others?
